VOL-01.note: Default name volume<N> as in SOEdit; also sphere, polyhedron from a .vol or new bytes, and vol.addFromMesh (box, cylinder, sphere, convex hull of the bone mesh) at vol.js:416. VOL-16.note: Op done; the drag itself in the 3D view belongs to the viewer and gizmos (E5) and would call vol.transform. Differs from SOEdit: scale goes into the box or cylinder sizes instead of being baked into the matrix, so the matrix stays a pure rotation; a polyhedron is pointed to vol.volTransform.
